Adventure Path is one of the events in Candy Crush Saga . It was released on 7 April 2021. Introduction In this event, the map is divided into two tracks, namely the main Saga path and the adventure path. The adventure path will embark the player on a new set of levels with unique content and experiences on a separate numbering system. The adventure path merges back into the main saga track before the episode concludes. Adventure path levels are alternative Reality levels. The player's score, stars, and mastery status will be counted as if the player has completed a main path level, so if the player passed N adventure path levels, they will advance N levels in the main path. Their high score and stars for level M + N will be that of the score for the N th adventure path level, where M is the last level before the player started the adventure path. Additionally, the player will not receive sugar stars and will miss out on the crown for this level (the crown and sugar stars would probably be assigned to the numbering on the adventure path, and reflected when the player scrolls all the way back) if they completed it on the adventure path. If the time ran out for this event, the players won't lose the levels of this event but will be booted back to the main path. Saga Adventures can be considered a spiritual successor of Adventure Path. Alien Invasion is one of the events in Candy Crush Saga . It's also one of the events in UFO Season. It was released on 14 October 2024. Introduction Much like the Volcanic Panic event, four of Tiffi's friends are kidnapped, and she has to save them, with each rescue level being an episode finale. At the end of an episode, one of Tiffi's friends is held captive in an Alien UFO, and a special ingredients level must be beaten to rescue them. The level in question requires you to bring down aliens to the board exits in the same way that you would with Gummi Dragons. The twist in these levels, however, is that the aliens are not on the board at the start. They're in an Alien UFO, a 2x2 blocker that holds the aliens. Making a match next to the ship will cause one alien to spawn on the topmost row of the board in a random column. The ship disappears when all aliens have been removed from it. When all of the aliens are brought down, the level is won and one of Tiffi's friends is freed. Freeing all of Tiffi's friends rewards you with a treasure chest with boosters inside. Trivia *This is the second event that introduces a new level type that's similar to an already-existing one. The first is Volcanic Panic, which introduced Bubblegum Levels. *It's also the second event that introduces a new blocker (the Alien UFO). The level in question requires you to bring down aliens to the board exits in the same way that you would with Gummi Dragons. The twist in these levels, however, is that the aliens are not on the board at the start. They're in an Alien UFO, a 2x2 blocker that holds the aliens. wiki_intro: All Stars is one of the events in Candy Crush Saga that is only available on mobile devices, even in the US. This event was officially introduced in UK on 13 September 2020. The event has returned as the annual premier tournament of Candy Crush Saga . A [https://candy-crush-all-stars.com/en/all separate] website was made specifically for this tournament. Introduction Each All Stars edition consist of a preliminary qualifier stage with several separate slots, multiple knockout stages, and a virtual final stage. Ten top contestants from the virtual final stage will be invited to the Live Finals , a televised event where the contestants can win large sums of real-life money. In the inaugural edition, the four rounds are: #Qualifiers Stage (3 rounds) #Quarter Final Stage (3 rounds) #Semi Final Stage (includes a Wild Card for any elimination, 2 rounds) #Finals Stage (Top 10 players will qualify for the Finals) The qualifiers stage event lasted for one day until September 27. If you attempt to play this stage the first day, it will go back into mini quest the next day and if you complete it, you will go to the leaderboard again. Ten players will win prizes while only the first place qualifies for the quarter final stage. You have to collect a certain kind of candy for the mini quest and the qualifiers stage. In quarter final stage, you have to collect striped candies. The semi-final stage requires wrapped candles. If you get between 2nd to 50th place that day, you will try it again

April Fool's Day 2020 (unofficial name) is a historically significant series of events and fundamental gameplay changes that started on or near 1 April 2020. It also coincides with the early days of the COVID-19 pandemic , and players were given infinite lives for entire days. On 1 April 2020, the trio of episodes E445~447, Sour Shoals, the second Lollipop Land, and Candy Crossing were hard-released. The trio E451~453, Playful Palace, Wonky Waters, Marshmallow Mound were granted early release on Windows 10, and they were released on 15 April. For this event, King celebrated with "jokes and pranks and fun!". [https://web.archive.org/web/20210128015436/https://community.king.com/en/blog/discussion/285617/up-for-some-april-fools-fun-special-guest-glenn1972 Up for some April Fools' fun?], King Community In spirit of this holiday, King made a couple temporary changes to the game. This could be due to the its partnership with the [https://www.who.int/ World Health Organization (WHO)] to help encourage all players and people in their homes to #PlayApartTogether and to self-isolate during the COVID-19 pandemic. [https://www.theverge.com/2020/3/31/21202056/king-candy-crush-saga-free-unlimited-lives-covid-coronavirus-who-social-distancing-partnership You can play Candy Crush with free, unlimited lives this week], The Verge These changes

Spoon is used for removing the frosting to uncover cookies. There are 5 characters: Tiffi, Mr. Toffee, Nutcracker, Misty and Yeti. Each character has its own board and rewards. Player must find and collect all cookie orders that are hidden by frostings, depending on the amount that the characters requires. After finding enough, the player will receive rewards by current character. The board will get wider as time the player goes on, making it hard to find the cookies. wiki_intro: Battle of the Bands is one of the events in Candy Crush Saga that requires players to collect as many candies (green/red/striped/wrapped/colour bomb) as they can. This is an alternate edition of the now-defunct Striped Candy Contest. Info In the competition, the player is required to collect a specified type of candies, depending on the planet. Only candies collected in a completed attempt of a level will be counted. Failing a level will lose all candies collected in that attempt. Candies collected by completing the latest progress level will be multiplied by 10. For example, if you are on Level 325 (and have not unlocked Level 326) and you complete it with 12 candies, you will earn 120 candies instead. There will be a given amount of opponent players in your group. Getting a higher place between them can win rewards and get a ticket to advance to the next stage. However, performing too poorly may result in a "return" ticket which sends you to the previous stage, once the competition ends. The event was released on 19 August 2021. It has a duration of 96 hours, running from 13:00 UTC Thursday until 13:00 UTC Monday. Collections The collections are as follows: ;Classical Crushers *Starting stage. You are required to collect green candies. *There are 50 players in each group. The first 15 players can get rewards and advance, with the first 3 places having better rewards. ;Dexter's Drummers *You are required to collect orange candies. *There are 30 players in each group. Beat the Buffet is one of the events in Candy Crush Saga . It was released on 9 February 2024. Instruction Unlike most candy-collecting contests, Beat the Buffet disregards candy collected on previous levels. Only your current level earns you points in this event. You have 60 minutes to collect as many candies of a particular type as you can, and you will compete against several other players. You must successfully clear the level to keep the points. Trivia *This event was upgraded to Factory Frenzy. Cake Climb is one of the events in Candy Crush Saga . In this event, the player must win a predetermined sequence of levels consecutively and in order without failing. If the players fail a level and met the level failure message, they must start over from the first level in the sequence. Cake Climb events, such as Golden Path, still make one-off appearances. The levels involved are derived from existing levels, and may differ per player and per replay. As of September 2022, with Candy Cup, Cake Climb has been nerfed significantly. The player will no longer slide down to the first level in the sequence. Description The wonderful Berry Baker has spent all day and all night baking the most delicious cake the world has ever seen, smelt, tasted or Instagramed. But in her rush to create cake perfection, she forgot to light the candles! Now the frosting is so slippery she can’t get to the top, that is where you come in! Berry Baker needs your help! You have 48hrs (from 22:00 GMT on 25/09/15) to light the candles at the top of the cake and if you succeed, the very merry Berry will reward you in the form of boosters and other goodies. Lighting the candles is simple but it’s definitely not easy; there are three levels to complete and each time you complete a level you light a candle. If you complete three levels in a row Berry Baker will shower you with epic gifts! If you fail a level, you’ll slip off the cake and will have to start right at the beginning, you will also lose a life! S

Candy Club was a premium feature in Candy Crush Saga . It was released in 2019 as a test feature. This feature was cancelled sometime in 2020. Info This is a seven-day subscription. The initial price (Launch Offer) was 1.99 USD to 2.99 USD depending on the test group. The advertised features for Candy Club include: *8 maximum lives (timed Charm of Life) *Exclusive levels released weekly (five extra levels per week, for the Club Chest , a Tasty Treasure equivalent offering only common boosters as prizes) *Elimination of display ads. The only ads are here to provide extra boosters. This feature was little-known, but from what we know, it has received negative reception. Suzy Fuller, one of the most productive YouTubers for this game, commented that this is a pay-to-play type deal [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=avI_kqxUwCA Candy Club...new offer from Candy Crush for exclusive levels], YouTube. Suzy stated that this is pay-to-play in nature at the 1:54 mark. The video is also proof that Candy Club is an event, and also showed concern of mass move buffing on hundreds of levels, including early levels. . Other players have reported that their Charm of Life effects applied intermittently [https://community.king.com/en/candy-crush-saga/discussion/comment/365855 New offer - Join Candy Club], King Community. . Candy Column was one of the events in Candy Crush Saga . It was a Christmas edition of Cake Climb. Info If you meet the level failure message, you will slide down to the first level. Exiting the level before making the first move however will not cause you to slide down (unless it is a timed level). *This was part of December 2015 events. *This event was not repeatable. Upon clearing the third level, you will also earn 6 hours of Live Forever, which is not on the list. *The levels were (4 colours), (+6 moves) and a level that was exclusive to this event.. **Of these levels, the third level was released earlier than the actual release in an episode. Trivia *This was the first time of a mobile event which has a change in the number of colours. *This was the first time a mobile event that contained a timed level. **But the info of the third level was incorrect, it should be 60,000 points instead of 100,000 points. *This was the first event which contains the character who is based on real person. *The main interface showed some boosters, which were not available on mobile version, including Bubblegum Troll (booster) and Sweet Teeth. Candy Cup is one of the events in Candy Crush Saga . It started on 15 September 2022 and ended on 7-10 October. The second edition started on 2 November 2023 and ended on 27 November 2023. The third edition was started on 24 June 2024 and finished on 15 July 2024. The fourth edition started on 4 September 2025 and ended in 20 September 2025. Description :;2024 version Crush your way to the top in the Candy Cup Get ready to go head-to-head against players from around the world for the chance to win the grand prize in the Candy Cup. The iconic match-3 puzzle game is giving away 1 million party boosters. Join thousands of winners, play for fun and win for days. Join the competition just by playing and collecting as many green trophy candies as you can. The more you collect, the higher you’ll climb on the leader boards for each level. Finish in the top to move on to the next round. The first place finisher in the final round wins the grand prize. But don’t fret if you miss a round. There’s a second chance stage for you to earn your way back into the competition. :--Google Play, [https://web.archive.org/web/20240731190530/https://play.google.com/store/apps/editorial?id=mc_editorialmd_games_candy_crush_candy_cup_fcp source] :;2026 version Candy Cup is back! Collect green candies to climb the leaderboard Collect green candies and compete through each round to reach the final. Top your leaderboard to win the grand prize of 30 Party Boosters. Play every day, keep climbing the rankings

Candy Jam Hoopfest was one of the events in Candy Crush Saga that required players to collect as many basketballs as they could. This was an alternate edition of the now-defunct Striped Candy Contest. Info It was a crossover event in celebration of the cinematic release of the movie Space Jam: A New Legacy on July 19, 2021. The event started on July 6, 2021 and ended on July 19, deliberately coinciding with the release of the movie. All orange candies were converted to basketballs. Candy Necklace (or Win Streak ) is one of the events in Candy Crush Saga . It was released on 6 October 2020. Its introduction was [https://community.king.com/en/candy-crush-saga/discussion/313634/candy-necklace-candy-crush-saga/p1 announced] by a King community manager. Candy Necklace is the successor of the Booster Bot, except that this event is permanent and your win streak can continue beyond the last stage. This event is continuously available since its introduction, cannot be skipped (unless by fresh reinstallation), and is not subject to a cooldown. The contents of the Candy Necklace are subject to change without notice. Levels before 200 are ineligible for the win streak. Appearance It appears as a colourful string of candies. There are five or six goodie bags of different colours. When the first level is done, the first bag appears to inflate. When you win the second level on the first try, the second bag appears to inflate, and the first bag is replaced by a checkmark, and so on. The last bag appears to have some leaves on it. When you click on each of the bags, it shows you the rewards. When you lose a level and are given an opportunity to play on, the necklace appears to stretch as if it's about to break. Your Win Streak does not necessarily have to match the number of levels from your last level you missed a crown on (or Level 200, whichever is later) to your last completed level, counted inclusively due to exempt levels, glitches and reinstallations, and the Str

Candy Royale is one of the events in Candy Crush Saga that is available on mobile and Facebook. It was released on 27 January 2022. Introduction In this event, you will compete in a team of 100 players. All players in your team are on the same level in the game as you are. The challenge is completing all 8 levels on the first attempt without losing a life on the main map within 24 hours. When you complete a level, you also will see the remaining players who complete it. If you fail or quit a level, Jelly Queen will bounce you out of the challenge. Remember, the event only works when Jelly Queen found all 99 others players on the same level as you. If she can't find 99 players, the event won't work. Reward The reward is 500 gold bars, and it will be split evenly between all players that completed the eight levels in a row in your group of 100 players. If you are the only one that completes all eight levels in a row without losing a life, then you will win the whole jackpot of gold bars. Trivia *In Candy Royale, players do not compete live with other players. Instead, players play against recordings of other players. **This also means that the 100 players may be playing different versions of levels. *In its beta version, players only needed to complete 6 levels consecutively. Caramel Cup is one of the events in Candy Crush Saga . It is a special tournament of Episode Race. It was released on 29 August 2026. Instruction Just like Episode Race, the player must race with 4 other players that have also started the same episode. Players will need to complete this episode faster than their opponents. Each player can confirm the progress of everyone in the group. Once a player has completed the episode finale, their place will be recorded, and the player can claim rewards. However in this tournament is completely different: There are 3 rounds total; the fellow players won't change in all 3 rounds and the player must finish at 1st place in all 3 rounds to grant the Grand Prize. At the end of first and second round, the last player standing will be eliminated. Players may receive smaller rewards as you progress through the tournament, while the main prize is awarded after winning all three rounds. This tournament also introduces an upcoming Entry Pass. The Episode Race will save the streak while you take part in Caramel Cup and will return after the tournament ends. This tournament only runs on weekends. The Grand Prize is 100 gold bars. Possible rewards may include: Gold bars, boosters, timed boosters and pin packs. Gallery File:Img-2016-png.png|Entry Pass Img-2017-2-png.png|Instruction Category:Events Category:Mobile features

Challenge Friend (or Challenge a Friend ) is one of the events in Candy Crush Saga that is available on mobile. It was released on 20 January 2022. Introduction Challenge others to get juicy rewards! In this event, the player can play against other players and try to win over them. It will pop up a notification after the player completed a hard level on the first attempt per day. The challenge is to get a Golden Crown for passing a level on the first try or complete a hard level. The player can send requests to up to 10 players a day. The players are chosen randomly. If someone already accepted the challenge or if the player accepted a challenge from another player, they will need to finish the challenge first before the next one can start. After challenging an unknown player and they accept the challenge, the player will also be able to add the player to the game so they can challenge each other again for a rematch. Reward The player will get rewarded with 1 booster for every friend they beat. The more challenges won, the more boosters will be waiting in the Golden chest. The reward will be given to the player who completed the task first. Gallery Challenge Friend info.png|Info Challenge Friend send challenge.png|Send challenge request Category:Events

Boosters help players to beat levels more easily in Royal Match. Pre-Level Boosters There are 3 pre-level boosters: Rocket, TNT, and Light Ball. They can be selected before starting a level, and when they are selected, the level will begin with the selected pre-level booster. In-Game Boosters Royal Hammer Royal Hammer clears one tile or removes one layer of any obstacle without using a move. Arrow Arrow clears the row of the selected tile and removes one layer of any obstacle without using a move. Cannon Cannon clears the column of the selected tile and removes one layer of any obstacle without using a move. Jester Hat Jester Hat shuffles all the tiles on the board without using a move. Advanced Agriculture Event is a Mayor's Competitions. *It is based on farming fields - counts the fields harvested. *Happy Times offer may take place during this event. Introduction Grow and harvest crops to complete your personal goal and earn tournament points. Complete group goals and earn a higher position on the tournament leaderboard to receive better rewards. Personal Goals Complete your personal goal by earning the required points to compete against 29 same-level players to see who can harvest the most number of crops. Each crop has a certain number of points when harvested. The players will be the same level as you when they join the tournament. All players will stay in this tournament group even if you or they level up. Once your plane is upgraded it can fly for longer. Make airplane fuel in the event's fuel factory using goods produced by your town. The fuel factory is located next to the event centre. Reward screen with stars collected, distance, and parts earned. Aerial Challenge Event Tips General Tips Here are some tips and tricks you might find helpful: * Don't fly too high up. The Season Adventure events are a recurring special month long event, where you complete regular tasks and event tasks to earn points. When you earn a certain amount of points, you can get rewards and perks. *You will need to collect the rewards and perks after they are unlocked as they are not automatically added to your inventory. You can choose to add them to your inventory at a later time if a task such as "Earn an "x" amount of Coins" is coming up then you can choose to collect any unlocked Coins rewards after the task is available. * Rewards last beyond the event, such as boosters, coupons etc. * Perks expire at the conclusion of the event, such as "Spacious Barn". *You do not regain these perks when a new event starts; a new event will bring new rewards and perks. *Rewards include coins, T-cash, gems, construction materials, co-op chat stickers, skins, coupons and lots more. *Some rewards are themed, such as the Skins, Co-op chat stickers and decorations. *Safes (or their equivalent) when opened will provide additional rewards. Unlimited safes can be opened by continuing to complete the tasks given. Please note: Recently there are different versions of the Season Adventure event that have been distributed by Playrix. {| class="article-table" style="vertical-align: middle;" | *Complete Sandra's tasks! *Earn points and get amazing prizes! |} Introduction to Gold Pass events The Gold Pass events are a recurring special Township event, where you complete regular tasks to earn points. When you earn a certain amount of points, you can get rewards and perks. *You will need to collect the rewards and perks after the are unlocked as they are not automatically added to your inventory. You can choose to add them to your inventory at a later time if a task such as "Earn an 'x' amount of Coins" is coming up later then you can choose to keep any unlocked Coins reward there to collect after the task is available. * Rewards last beyond the event, such as boosters, coupons etc. * Perks expire at the conclusion of the event, such as "Spacious Barn". *You do not regain these perks when a new event starts; a new event will bring new rewards and perks. *Rewards include coins, T-cash, gems, construction materials, co-op chat stickers, skins, coupons and lots more. *Some rewards are themed, such as the Skins, Co-op chat stickers and decorations. *Safes (or their equivalent) when opened will provide additional rewards. Unlimited safes can be opened by continuing to complete the tasks given. Please note: Recently there are different versions of the Gold Pass event that have been played. The details below may not reflect your current game play. Event Guide Beach Vacation Guide 1.png Beach Vacation Guide 2.png Beac

__TOC__ Bloom & Buzz * Bloom & Buzz is a time-limited event where you progress by growing a plant along with a partner you play with — and unlock rewards. * Each event lasts 10 days in total. * Play match-3 levels and complete helicopter orders (max 10 a day) to earn beads and spend them on a plinko minigame to earn points. * Grow plants by earning the required number of points in the progress bar. * Grow all four plants to unlock the Grand Prize. Note : * You need at least one partner to start, and you can play with up to three partners selected from friends, team members, or players from the suggested list. * An internet connection is required to start the event and manage partners, but progress can continue offline. How are partners assigned? You can invite friends or team members, or pick partners from the suggested players list. Once all partner slots are filled, the invite option closes. How do I earn beads? Most players earn tokens by completing match-3 levels: *Normal: 1 bead *Hard: 3 beads *Super Hard: 5 beads Other players are in a group that earns tokens by completing tasks (up to 20 per task). Tokens may also appear in the Match-3 events (Treasure Tree, Green Machine, Ernie's Cup, Farmer's Race, and Disco Fever), Mayor events (Mayor's Weekend, Mayor's Duties), ongoing expedition treasure hunt and through helicopter orders(max 7 tokens). {| class="article-table" style="vertical-align: middle;" | *Complete Eugene's tasks to earn points and get amazing prizes *Buy the golden ticket to get premium rewards *32 days *Big Roll special offer may be available |} How do Season Adventure events work? The Season Adventure events are a recurring special month long event, where you complete regular tasks and event tasks to earn points. When you earn a certain amount of points, you can get rewards and perks. *You will need to collect the rewards and perks after they are unlocked as they are not automatically added to your inventory. You can choose to add them to your inventory at a later time if a task such as "Earn an "x" amount of Coins" is coming up then you can choose to collect any unlocked Coins rewards after the task is available. * Rewards last beyond the event, such as boosters, coupons etc. * Perks expire at the conclusion of the event, such as "Spacious Barn". *You do not regain these perks when a new event starts; a new event will bring new rewards and perks. *Rewards include coins, T-cash, gems, construction materials, co-op chat stickers, skins, coupons and lots more. *Some rewards are themed, such as the Skins, Co-op chat stickers and decorations. *Safes (or their equivalent) when opened will provide additional rewards. Unlimited safes can be opened by continuing to complete the tasks given. Please note: Recently there are different versions of the Season Adventure event that have been distributed by Playrix

Decorations Introduction Almost every time you level up there will be some new decorations to buy in the Township Store . Some of the decorations are free, many can be bought for coins , others for gems and a few for T-cash . *Decorations with water drops (💧) must be placed on water. *Decorations listed with stars (★/⭐️) are animated. Decoration Lists You can view lists of decorations depending on which arrangement you prefer: *Decorations in Store (default, no Event Decorations) *Event Decorations *All Decorations (large table) Roads Design your town with free roads, landscape and pavement. There are 4 types of roads to connect places and create surfaces for townspeople and vehicles. All roads are available from the beginning of the game. You can get the Road Champ achievement for placing up to 450 roads in your Town and/or Zoo. wiki_intro: The airport is a restorable special building which introduces the airplane. At level 17, you will be asked to reconstruct the airport. "The airport has been abandoned for quite some time! In order to reconstruct it, you need 1500 coins." After reconstructing the airport you unlock the Pilot's profile picture. Airplane Landing and Preparation Airplanes are automatically sent off within 15 hours if you don't press the send button, you will not receive the reward for the rows of crates you have filled. The next airplane will arrive in 5 hours whether it is automatically sent off or not. The plane will not arrive unless you have opened the game after the plane has arrived. Produce goods in advance, grow crops overnight, and use the market to complete plane requests quickly. For goods, you can preview items required to fill the next plane. It also lets you know how many of the goods you have in your barn if you tap on them. However, it does not tell you exactly how many of each item you will need. Township Cash Information Cash, T-cash or Township Cash is the secondary currency mainly used to speed up, buy missing goods, purchase special decorations or earn additional moves after losing a match-3 level. The amount of cash which you have can be found at the top-right corner, or at the Store . Earning Cash T-cash can be earned in various ways: *Beating Match-3 levels gives you T-cash ( 10 for Normal levels, 100 for Hard Levels, 150 for Super-Hard levels ). Town Expansion Information In the beginning you start with 40 expansions and some land near the Co-op building by the rocks. Not one of these free expansions count towards the Boundless Domain achievement. Tap a $ -sign on a plot to see what it costs. Help a Teammate & SOS Help a teammate or SOS offer is a time-limited offer, where you can send a help request in your team chat, so your teammates can beat the level for you! How does it work? * Team Members can request for help every 8 hours * The teammate who helped you beat the level will get coins and unlimited lives, and you'll get a star. * Everyone in the team can only get 5 tries to beat the level. * If the team fails all 5 tries then no one gets a chance to beat in the same request. You have to send a new request after 8 hours. * If no one answers your request, it disappears after a certain time. If you still need help, you can send a new request after 8 hours. * Your teammates can only help you beat levels in the main chain of levels. You cannot ask for help in Tournament of Champions levels. * You need a stable internet connection to send a request.

are major layered obstacles in Homescapes having up to 6 stages. To remove Boxes, make matches or activate Power-ups. Tips on Boxes *Bombs, rockets and rainbow balls destroy boxes faster. Players no longer experience this, but it may return. **In addition, high-layered boxes are very underused. **Also, high-layered boxes mostly appear in levels where Vacuums are used to clear them. Levels are the main objective of Homescapes, each with a new match-3 puzzle and different elements for variety. As of September 2026, there are over 21,000 levels. Currently, there are 21100 levels. Playrix releases up to fifty new levels every Thursday or Friday. *Each level has an objective that must be achieved within a limited amount of moves. A level can have up to four objectives. *If you run out of moves, you can purchase extra moves and power-ups to continue, or you can retry the level, which will cost you a life and any equipped boosters. You may also quit the level early, but doing so will also cost you a life and any boosters. *Beating levels will grant you stars , which are essential to complete tasks and progress through the storyline. *You will also earn coins that may be used to buy boosters, lives, and event resources. *When you reach a certain level, you will be able to join a team and participate in competitions and events. *Levels can only be beaten once. You cannot replay them unless they reappear in the Olympus Cup or as one shot levels. *As levels keep evolving, some new elements might be introduced in early levels for new players. Note: The number of new levels released in Russia is different from other countries. This is mainly because levels are tested first before releasing. This is a recurring event where you earn special currency, pickaxes, by passing match-3 levels. Use this currency to remove blockers on the board and uncover hidden items that will help you complete each stage. How it works * Earn pickaxes by passing match-3 levels. * Use pickaxes to remove blockers and uncover gemstones hidden under tiles. * The event is divided into 5 stages, each with unique goals and game fields. * To complete each stage, you need to find all the hidden items. * Each stage rewards you for completing all the goals, but you'll need to clear the blockers to uncover the hidden items. * The event lasts for 4 days, and you must uncover all items to progress to the next stage. Please note: * The event is available to players who have passed level 25 (i.e., from level 26 onward). * The event is time-limited and lasts for 4 days. * It’s available on both regular levels and Golden Cup levels. * A stable internet connection is required to start the event, but once it’s launched, you can continue playing offline. {| class="article-table" style="width:100%; text-align:center; table-layout:fixed;" border="1" |- ! The Golden Cup is a competition between players who've beaten all the levels in the main chain of levels. * The objective of the Tournament is to win great prizes, which you get by holding a spot among the top ten on the leaderboard. * Players climb the leaderboard by beating special levels and earning gold cups. You get one cup for beating one level. * The earlier you join the The Golden Cup, the better the prizes! Important note: * New levels are regularly added to the main chain of levels. The faster you beat them, the sooner you're able to join the Tournament and earn a spot among the top players. * If you lose your internet connection while playing levels, you'll still be awarded golden cups, but you need to reconnect to the internet to access the leaderboard. What happens to Gold cups after the Event? The Golden Cup is a time-limited event, and it only appears in the game during certain periods of time. Once the Tournament is over, new levels get added to the main chain of levels in the game. After you've beaten them, you can take part in the next Golden Cup, where the tally of gold cups for all players is reset. Rewards Rewards mainly depend on the day you start the tournament. Difficulty *All dragons are locked in five-layered chests whose keys are provided in liquorice locks. *Even on a wider board, five colours may make it harder to set up a combination and use it, especially in a scant 15 moves. *The dragons are worth 50,000 points, 5 dragons × 10,000 points per dragon = 50,000 points which is equal to one-star target score. Stars Strategy *Clear the sugar keys quickly. This will open the sugar chests and move the dragons to the board. *At least one good combo is extremely vital to passing without the use of boosters. Trivia *On mobile, the teleporter exits may glitch and act as candy spawners instead of letting ingredients through. {{Infobox_Special_Building|title1 = Academy of Industry|level = 22|coin = 2 6 |population = 810|time = 1d 17h|xp = 269|size = 2 x 2|image1 = Academy of Industry.png}} Academy of Industry Information You can build the Academy of Industry at level 22, with 810 population, and using 2 silver and 6 bronze ingots. At the Academy of Industry you can view a list of your current factories, trains and islands available for upgrading with ingots, which can be produced at the foundry. The level of a factory/train/isle is shown by the number in the star icon . *Tap the star to see which attributes can be upgraded. *Tap on the factory upgrade icon to take you directly to that specific upgrade in the academy of industry. *Tap the upgrade you want to complete, then confirm by selecting an attribute to increase. Missing ingots are in red, and you can tap to see the T-cash cost to upgrade right away. Available Upgrades * Factories : 2 extra shelves, reduce production time for goods, gain more experience, and sell goods for more coins. ** Attributes always increase by 5% per upgrade and include time, experience and coins. ** Time upgrades can be done at level 2, 4, 6, 8, 11, 14, 17, 20, 23, and 26. ** Shelves are added at level 5 (+1) and again at level 10 (+2). The max shelves is 8. ** With 2 extra shelves you can buy more production boxes in factories for T-cash (7 boxes maximum). ** When filling orders the extra experience and coins you gain depend on your factories attributes. * Feed Mills

{{Infobox_Special_Building|title1 = City Market|level = 13|coin = 1,700|population = 250|time = 18h|xp = 75|size = 3 x 3|image1 = City Market.png}} __TOC__ City Market Information The City Market is available to purchase at level 13 with a population of 250. It costs 1,700 coins to build. You can buy goods with coins for the helicopter, trains or planes, your barn, or for filling friends orders. Market Refresh The market refreshes every 6 hours, but can be sped up with a low T-cash price or use the Vibrant Market booster to reduce the time by 50% (3 hours). The market booster can be combined with the Generous Customer booster to obtain a lot of coins. Generous Market Perk The market and dealer have more goods for sale when the Generous Market Perk is on, which may occur during the Gold Pass events. This is only active until the end of the event. Please note that this is not a coupon, it is a perk. Market Boxes You may start with 10 market boxes (subject to change) . Each market box contains a random product. You can buy more market boxes with T-cash. There's no limit to the number of market boxes you may purchase. *Market Boxes can contain many of the same Goods in different quantities and cost. *Market Boxes never contain Ores or goods from the Foundry or Jewelry Store. Cost Market boxes start at 5 T-cash per box and will increase to a max cost of 30 T-cash per box. {{Infobox_Special_Building|title1 = Event Center|level = 8|time = Instant when an event is held|size = Fixed location|image1 = .png}} The is available at level 8 and is located in front of the train station and the zoo entry. Limited-time events are held for players to compete with other players and earn a variety of rewards including coins, T-cash, construction materials, zoo decks, boosters and profile pictures. When there is no event, you are unable do anything with this building site. Event Workshop/Factory The event workshop (also called event factory, supply factory or fuel factory) is located in front of the . It works when a community event or seasonal event is held. It aims at producing items to play the mini game at the . In recent years no events have used the event workshop. The workshop now uses a default skin and when clicked will take the player to the main event. Event Calendar The event calendar was a special calendar which had information on the present events, special offers, and upcoming events. Information includes number of days/hours left and event guide. As of January 2025 it has been removed. are items in Homescapes that you can use to make a level easier. As of today, there are 2 types of boosters: Pre-Game and In-Game . When you're out of a booster, you can purchase 3 more with coins. The Lucky Spin is an ingame-feature where you can win prizes every day. * It opens automatically when you launch the game. * Spin the wheel to win prizes. * You can only play the Lucky Spin once daily. * Unfortunately, uncollected bonuses don't save or accumulate.
